name: Seeded Local Community Detection
shortfall_explanation: PPR/diffusion kernels omit the required seed-containing conductance sweep and community result. They remain building blocks, not complete local-community algorithms.
limitation_notes: A matching input variant can qualify without supporting every optional mode. Missing canonical adapters and absent runtime validation remain separate from research collection eligibility.
